home.alt: Top no-strings savings rate we track: Pibank 4.40% vs the 0.38% US average
home.line: Pibank pays it with no conditions. The US average is 0.38%.

markets.alt: 30-year mortgage rate 7.32%: about $2,748 a month on a $400,000 loan
markets.line: About $2,748/mo on a $400,000 loan, vs $2,468 a year ago. Freddie Mac, Oct 22.

cards.alt: Robinhood Gold Card pays $660 a year after fees on $2,000 a month of spending; best no-fee card Citi Double Cash pays $480
cards.line: Robinhood Gold Card on $2,000/mo of spending, after its fee. Best no-fee card: Citi Double Cash, $480.

best-hysa.alt: $10,000 earns $440 a year at Pibank (4.40%) vs $38 at the 0.38% US average savings rate
best-hysa.line: on $10,000 at Pibank’s 4.40%, vs $38 at the 0.38% US average.

best-nofee-cards.alt: A flat 2% no-fee card pays about $480 a year on $24,000 of spending
best-nofee-cards.line: from a flat 2% no-fee card on $24,000 a year of spending. Category cards win only on heavy dining or groceries.

tbills-vs-savings-california.alt: In California’s 9.3% bracket a 4.33% 26-week T-bill keeps 4.33% while 4.40% savings keeps 3.99% after state tax
tbills-vs-savings-california.line: A 26-week T-bill keeps all 4.33%. A 4.40% savings account keeps 3.99% after CA tax (9.3% bracket).

pay-property-tax-credit-card.alt: California counties charge 2.22% to 2.30% to pay property tax by credit card; eCheck is free
pay-property-tax-credit-card.line: card fee charged by CA counties. eCheck is free. A 2% card loses money; a bonus minimum can win.
